Package pt.pa.controller

Enum Class TransportMapFeature

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<TransportMapFeature>
pt.pa.controller.TransportMapFeature
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<TransportMapFeature>, Constable
public enum TransportMapFeature extends Enum<TransportMapFeature>
Represents all transport map features available in the app. Each transport map feature has a tab index and the name of the tab and bottom view files.

    Enum Constant
    Description
    CALCULATE_ROUTE
    The transport map feature that calculates an optimal path between stops.
    DEACTIVATE_ROUTE
    The transport map feature that deactivates a specific transport mode in a route.
    DESIGN_ROUTE
    The transport map feature that allows the design of a route.
    FIND_STOPS
    The transport map feature that finds all stops that are as far as selected from a stop.

    The transport map feature that shows the logs of the user actions.

    The transport map feature that shows the network base information.
